Theo VietnamFinance và CafeLand, 90 căn: According to VietnamFinance and CafeLand, 90 apartments at the project are collateral for a 200 billion VND loan from 2018 (the borrower is a real estate development company in Quang Nam); IVB bank has put them up for sale to recover the debt at an initial starting price of over 289 billion VND, and several auction sessions have failed.
